newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Midopa, Dainong rise to limits.
newsitem.headline: Midopa, Dainong rise to limits.

text.p: Shares in Midopa Department Co and Dainong Corp rose to their respective daily limits on Monday on news that they would be bailed out, brokers said.
Retailer Midopa was up 600 won to 8,140 and textile maker Dainong up 230 won to 3,180.
"Investors now think the two companies have avoided immediate failure," said Koh Soon-shik of LG Securities.

A SEOULBANK spokesman said the two companies and two other unlisted firms of the group had been designated for bail-out, under an earlier agreement among major banks to prevent promising companies from collapsing.
Details are due to be announced later on Monday.
The Dainong Group has been troubled by heavy debts since earnings by its affiliates worsened in line with a cyclical downturn of the national economy.
